items.title: Uric acid remodels gut microbiota to fuel obesity.
items.one_liner: Obesity and hyperuricemia frequently coexist, yet researchers have long lacked a causal framework regarding the two disorders. In this issue of Cell Host & Microbe, Tian et al. address this gap by mapping a uric acid-driven liver-gut axis that remodels gut microbiota, thereby promoting dietary lipid absorption and further obesity.
